Migrate camellia labelexpert module pages (#499)

## Summary
- add a concrete `woodii/src/views/app/labelexpert/mscene.vue` leaf entry so permission-driven menu routing opens the migrated `mscene` page instead of the placeholder view
- remove hard-coded `metaprint` app and fixed `/app/labelexpert/mscene` route assumptions from the `device` / `scene` / `mscene` pages so list, detail, and manage flows follow the active module context
- align the migrated `scene` and `mscene` pages with the shared camellia list/form/dialog flow and widen shared tree-view typings to support the string ids returned by the existing backend payloads

## Testing
- `cd woodii && (npm run typecheck || true) | rg "src/views/app/labelexpert/(scene|device|mscene)|src/api/universal/(scene|mscene|mscene-item)|src/components/tree-view|src/types/vendor"`
- `cd woodii && npm run build:dev`
- `cd woodii && npm run build:stg`
